description: This file generates a salary payments report based on payment modes, including functions for data retrieval, processing, and chart generation within an ERP system.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate the salary payments report, returning columns, data, chart, and summary.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report based on payment modes.

methods.name: get_payment_modes
methods.description: Retrieves distinct payment modes from Salary Slip records.

methods.name: prepare_data
methods.description: Prepares branch-wise salary data and total gross pay.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches salary data, processes totals, and prepares report summary.

methods.name: get_total_based_on_mode_of_payment
methods.description: Calculates total amounts per payment mode.

methods.name: get_report_summary
methods.description: Generates summary data for gross pay, deductions, and net pay.

methods.name: get_chart
methods.description: Creates a bar chart visualization of payment modes.
